text:
Which statement about the motion of molecules describes the process of evaporation?
A
Molecules break free from their fixed positions.
B
Freely moving molecules collide and join together.
C
Molecules escape from the surface of a liquid.
D
Freely moving molecules gain energy and move further apart.

options.label: A
options.text: Molecules break free from their fixed positions.

options.label: B
options.text: Freely moving molecules collide and join together.

options.label: C
options.text: Molecules escape from the surface of a liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: Freely moving molecules gain energy and move further apart.
